THE ENTIRE BACKGROUND MUST BE SOLID PURE MAGENTA, RGB(255,0,255), edge to edge, filling every pixel that is not the statue itself — a flat chroma-key backdrop, NOT white, NOT grey, NOT a coloured wash, NOT a gradient, NOT a vignette, NOT a scene, NOT a border or frame. No grass, no sky, no ground shadow, no text, no watermark, no second copy, no silhouette.

A stone garden statue of the Good Shepherd: a standing robed man carrying a lamb across his shoulders, one hand holding the lamb's legs, a shepherd's crook in the other hand.

Carved from the SAME pale weathered limestone throughout — warm grey-beige stone, NOT marble, NOT bronze, NOT gold, NOT painted, NOT gilded, and with no colour on the figure at all beyond the stone. The whole monument stands on a simple square stone plinth two steps high, with a little moss at its base so it reads as having stood there a while. Warm hand-illustrated storybook style, clean shapes and soft painted shading, no line art, no photorealism. Seen straight on from ground level, the WHOLE monument inside the frame, plinth included, with the base of the plinth sitting on the bottom edge. Lit warmly from the upper left; values separated clearly enough that the silhouette still reads against a dark blue-green night lawn at 40 pixels tall.
